mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (course_id, slot_id, customer_id, people, status, note, created_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{slotId}, #{customerId}, #{people}, #{status}, #{note}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id as reservationId, s.date as date, s.time as time, c.name as courseName, r.people as people, cust.name as customerName, cust.email as email, cust.phone as phone, r.note as note, r.status as status FROM reservations r JOIN slots s ON r.slot_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.id JOIN customers cust ON r.customer_id = cust.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM reservations ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT r.id as reservationId, s.date as date, s.time as time, c.name as courseName, r.people as people, cust.name as customerName, r.status as status FROM reservations r JOIN slots s ON r.slot_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.id JOIN customers cust ON r.customer_id = cust.id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
